component.name: com.hyland.hxpr.runtime.pubsub.PubSubService
component.documentation: The PubSub service allows cross-instance notifications through simple messages sent to topics.

extension-point.name: configuration
extension-point.documentation:
Defines the implementation of the PubSub provider to use. The provider is responsible for sending and receiving messages to/from other instances.
The class must implement com.hyland.hxpr.runtime.pubsub.PubSubProvider.
